columns.name: lead_stage

columns.name: outside_area_grace_ms
columns.comment: Continuous milliseconds outside the assigned working area before session-control auto-stops the field session. Production default: 1,800,000 ms (30 minutes).

columns.name: customer_first_name

columns.name: customer_last_name
columns.comment: Nullable because McCoy no longer asks the rep to re-enter customer information after returning from an ISP dashboard.

columns.name: service_address
columns.comment: Optional lead context captured before provider routing; it is not required after the provider sale attempt.

columns.name: att_mobile_lines
columns.comment: Legacy compatibility mirror of mobile_phone_lines for all providers.

columns.name: verification_status
columns.comment: pending_verification, verified_processed, low_potential, mismatch, rejected

columns.name: competition_eligible
columns.comment: True only when provider order is verified to the linked seller identity for the McCoy rep.

columns.name: att_device_count
columns.comment: Legacy compatibility mirror of mobile_device_count for all providers.

columns.name: att_device_protection
columns.comment: Legacy compatibility mirror of mobile_device_protection for all providers.

columns.name: install_date
columns.comment: Customer installation date selected when the order is processed.

columns.name: directv_service
columns.comment: Specific DIRECTV service ordered; populated when the service catalog is configured.

columns.name: vivint_service
columns.comment: Specific Vivint service ordered; populated when the service catalog is configured.

columns.name: provider_capture_id
columns.comment: Links the completed McCoy sale to the provider-dashboard capture that initiated it.

columns.name: rep_distance_from_customer_meters
columns.check: rep_distance_from_customer_meters IS NULL OR rep_distance_from_customer_meters >= 0::double precision
columns.comment: Approximate straight-line map distance from the rep location available to McCoy when the sale was saved to the selected customer address coordinates. Informational only.

columns.name: rep_location_accuracy_meters
columns.check: rep_location_accuracy_meters IS NULL OR rep_location_accuracy_meters >= 0::double precision

columns.name: distance_measurement_status
columns.comment: Indicates whether an informational map distance could be recorded. This value does not approve, reject, rank, or calculate pay for a sale.

columns.name: ranking_eligible
columns.comment: True for completed McCoy outcomes and Admin-approved verified provider credits unless rejected, marked not-a-sale, or explicitly excluded.

columns.name: ranking_credit_excluded
columns.comment: Admin-selected No rep state. Excludes the sale from rankings without changing accounting eligibility or the underlying sale owner.

columns.name: rep_reported_outcome
columns.comment: Explicit completed outcome reported in McCoy. This is preliminary and does not itself grant ranking or pay eligibility.

columns.name: att_mobile_lines
columns.comment: Legacy compatibility mirror of mobile_phone_lines for all providers.

columns.name: celebration_messages
columns.comment: Server-authored public celebration scripts. Customer and order details are intentionally excluded.

columns.name: source_scope
columns.comment: Origin of the evidence. Rep-account reports are preliminary; dealer-account reports are authoritative.

columns.name: cross_reference_status
columns.comment: Dealer cross-reference result for rep-account evidence. This field never grants compensation eligibility by itself.

columns.name: materialization_status
columns.comment: Automation outcome. Only unique seller + capture matches create a non-payable sale pending Admin review.

tables.name: public.apple_notes_folder_allowlist
tables.comment: Only folders explicitly authorized by an administrator may be accepted by Apple Notes sync.

tables.name: public.apple_notes_documents
tables.comment: Notes received only from an explicitly authorized Apple Notes folder via the secured sync function.

tables.name: public.provider_sale_captures
tables.comment: Durable record that a rep opened or attempted to open an external provider dashboard while processing a McCoy sale. Captures do not count for ranking or pay until linked to an ISP-verified sales_records row.

columns.name: rep_outcome
columns.comment: Explicit rep-reported provider attempt outcome. Abandoned captures never create a sales_records row.

tables.name: public.provider_identity_owner_controls
tables.comment: Admin-only atomic ownership switch for provider seller identities. Target must already be an active McCoy Admin.

columns.name: pending_admin_email
columns.comment: Optional future Admin email; null until the alternate Admin account is created.

tables.name: public.pending_named_role_designations
tables.comment: Pre-designates a requested signup role by name but never grants access without Admin verification of the actual email.

tables.name: public.provider_corporate_access
tables.comment: Internal allowlist for importing authoritative corporate provider reports. Provider identities never grant McCoy app roles.

tables.name: public.provider_seller_assignment_history
tables.comment: Immutable audit log of Admin assignments from unmatched ISP seller identities to active McCoy users.

columns.name: home_label

columns.name: home_accuracy_meters
columns.check: home_accuracy_meters IS NULL OR home_accuracy_meters >= 0::double precision AND home_accuracy_meters <= 100::double precision

columns.name: accuracy_meters
columns.check: accuracy_meters IS NULL OR accuracy_meters >= 0::double precision AND accuracy_meters <= 10000::double precision

tables.name: public.lead_removal_audit
tables.comment: Private immutable audit of reversible lead-list removals, including actor, reason, canonical duplicate, and original lead snapshot.

tables.name: public.user_account_removal_history
tables.comment: Immutable Admin audit of McCoy access removal and Supabase Auth soft deletion; historical accounting identities remain referenced.

tables.name: public.lead_geocode_verifications
tables.comment: Server-only audit of Google Maps geocoding comparisons and pin-placement decisions.

tables.name: public.sale_order_photo_pilot_samples
tables.comment: Admin-only 30-50 screenshot pilot. Stores redaction attestations, suggestion-only extraction, independently entered ground truth, and server-computed field accuracy.

tables.name: public.lead_contact_edit_history
tables.comment: Immutable audit trail for organization-scoped lead customer-name, phone, notes, and field-created address changes.

tables.name: public.auth_email_provider_settings
tables.comment: Non-secret production mail readiness state. SMTP credentials remain in managed secret stores.

columns.name: sender_email
columns.check: sender_email IS NULL OR sender_email = lower(btrim(sender_email))

tables.name: public.auth_email_delivery_events
tables.comment: Auditable Auth email requests and provider delivery events. Provider webhook IDs plus recipients make ingestion idempotent.
